name: Absolution Guardian
summary: Absolution turns a single cast into a squad of lightning sentinels that keep attacking while you move. The Guardian shell supplies the defences and the relic army, so the build is a relaxed mapper that still has a real boss rotation, and it needs no unique.

pros.text: The sentinels fight for you, so you can dodge while the damage continues.
Guardian defences and relics make the build forgiving to learn.
No required unique; the damage comes from gem levels and minion notables.
Absolution clears packs while the sentinels spread to the next group.
The same caster gear works for a later minion or spell build.
A relaxed league starter for a player who dislikes aiming.

cons.text: Sentinel AI decides part of the fight; they can lag behind a fast player.
Single-target needs the sentinels alive and positioned before the burst.
Recasting Absolution is a damage loss when a pack dies too quickly.
The build is slower than a bow or a well-geared melee mapper.
Elemental reflect maps remain a hard no.

summary.text: Absolution Guardian turns one cast into a squad of lightning sentinels that keep attacking while you move. It measures 91.6k at red maps and 59.2k at pinnacle, and needs no unique.

leveling.text: Level with Holy Flame Totem until Absolution is available, then keep the sentinels between you and the pack. The first checkpoint measures 372 life and 39 damage; the second measures 149.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 91.6k damage, 46283 effective life and 16069 physical max hit. Keep the sentinels refreshed ahead of the pack and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 59.2k damage with 52515 effective life and 14803 physical max hit. Recast Absolution before the burst, keep Convocation ready, and move when the slam lands.
